metadata.technology_specification: Man-portable thermal imaging sight with uncooled microbolometer sensor
metadata.technology_reasoning: Man-portable thermal imaging sights typically use uncooled microbolometer sensors due to their compact size, low power consumption, and cost-effectiveness. These devices are standard in military and law enforcement markets for thermal target detection and visibility enhancement in portable form factors as of 2024.

components.reasoning: Core thermal detection component universally present and procured as a distinct module in all thermal imaging sights.
Critical for focusing infrared radiation onto the sensor; typically a separate assembly optimized for thermal wavelengths.

components.component: Image Processing Unit (IPU) or Signal Processing Board
components.reasoning: Processes raw sensor data into a visible thermal image, standard electronic board integral to device functionality.
Provides visual output of the processed thermal image, commonly an integrated but separately manufacturable component.
Portable power source essential for standalone operation, usually a removable or replaceable battery pack.
Includes buttons, switches, and control boards allowing user operation; standard for device usability though integration varies.
Protects internal components and provides ergonomic handling; procured as a distinct mechanical assembly designed to withstand harsh environments.
Ensures stable internal temperature and environmental protection, common but sometimes integrated within housing rather than separate.
